September 12th? But that is far away, and anyway, as I told you, it has already been three weeks since I placed the order! This is simply not acceptable. I need that laptop bag urgently for my office work. 

Since the delivery is so heavily delayed, kindly process a full refund for me at the earliest. Also, please escalate this matter to your supervisor so they are aware of such poor courier service. Do the needful, please.
